svg.text: C4 Component Diagram — Resource Manager / Actuator
Scope: one C4 container · proposed design · supporting systems are outside the container boundary.

text.tspan: Resource Manager / Actuator — C4 container boundary
Accepts admitted requests and returns outcomes on the same connection.
Checks kernel peer identity against the approved caller policy.
Checks action fields, resource whitelist, numeric bounds, and mode.
Rechecks PID identity, ownership, target cgroup, and resource capability.
Applies and reads back gated cpu.weight, memory.high, or supported io.weight/io.max.
Records denials, action, read-back, recovery, and failure outcomes.

Key: blue rectangles are components; teal cylinders are the separate SQLite databases; grey boxes are external systems/interfaces. UML port squares, required sockets, and provided lollipops show named interfaces. Dashed arrows show consumer → provider dependency by project convention.
